prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit open-air stone terrace at midday with a pale paved floor, a waist-high balustrade, potted palms and a standard-height doorway, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Ukrainian man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty-boy idol face with flawless smooth skin, large clear eyes, a slim jaw and soft full lips, clean-shaven, pearly white eyeshadow with a clear gloss lip and soft blush, fair smooth skin, a calm gentle gaze, soft pastel-mint-green hair styled in elegant updo, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a tin pyramid-shaped lump, a silver small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked gold necklaces. Extremely long stiletto nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful man, far beyond any real person. A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme gold plain stiletto pumps with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Hawaiian man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a fresh-faced boy-group idol face with clear glowing skin, bright eyes and a gentle smile line, clean-shaven, sparkling glitter dusted under the eyes with rose-gold eyeshadow, smooth warm bronze skin, a cool composed look, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in half-up, top section lifted with the length flowing loose below, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large copper hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a silver small flared temple bell, a silver pyramid-shaped lump, a silver barrel-shaped weight, a bronze square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a lead teardrop-shaped sinker, a bronze square-sided cowbell, a silver miniature anvil, a copper round bell, a silver ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three silver anklets. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
